chapter: Kid Ory, Hampton, Ellington and Ben Webster
title: Meeting Sy Johnson at a Boston radio station
summary: Mingus and Johnson recall how they first met when Johnson was a disc jockey and played classical music.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: How about you, man? You have a disc jockey.
That's right, well, I did all kinds of things for the station. The jazz shows I did for nothing, just to keep my sanity.
You were doing jazz when I first met you. You did -- George (inaudible).
Yeah. With Red Norvo, I think.
Yeah, maybe, yeah. No, it wasn't Red Norvo, because I remember --
George Williams. And George took me up to your place.
I remember you had this -- Audrey was working for you.
And when I went up there, you was
I did that, too, yeah. I used to do a classical show, where I played the music first, before I'd tell who the composer was or the performer.
I always thought you'd be a good disc jockey because you ears for that.
